children.title: Cycle 30 · Synthesis of Causal Memory and Thermodynamic Dissipation Limits

detail.title: Synthesis of Causal Memory and Thermodynamic Dissipation Limits
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes updated findings regarding the operational requirements of causal memory, the role of predictive information in modulating dissipation in nonequilibrium engines, and the thermodynamic scaling laws governing memory reliability. Research confirms that coarse-graining and finite spatial resolution impose fundamental bounds on the retrievability of causal information, while nonreciprocal interactions in quantum dot systems modulate inter-element information flow and entropy production. The synthesis confirms that predictive processing serves as a mechanism to mitigate thermodynamic costs in finite-lived information engines, provided the predictive model accounts for its own dissipative footprint.
